proof_body:
by
  intro a ha
  have h := intervalIntegral.integral_comp_mul_left (a := -1) (b := 1) (fun x => Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - x ^ 2)) ha.ne'
  have hscale : ∀ u : ℝ, Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - (a * u) ^ 2) = a * Real.sqrt (1 - u ^ 2) := by
    intro u
    rw [show a ^ 2 - (a * u) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 * (1 - u ^ 2) by ring, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg a), Real.sqrt_sq ha.le]
  simp only [hscale] at h
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integral_sqrt_one_sub_sq] at h
  simp only [mul_neg, mul_one, smul_eq_mul] at h
  have hne := ha.ne'
  have : (∫ x in (-a)..a, Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - x ^ 2)) = a * (a * (Real.pi / 2)) := by
    rw [h]
    field_simp
  rw [this]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (a : ℝ), 0 < a → (∫ x in (-a)..a, Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 - x ^ 2)) = Real.pi * a ^ 2 / 2
